t: Trump Says Would 'Love' to Have Putin at G20 Summit in Miami
d: US President Donald Trump said on Friday that he did not know if Russian President Vladimir Putin is planning to attend the G20 summit in Miami, but he would "love" to have him.

t: Trump Orders That Certain Measures Stipulated by Russia Sanctions Act Not Be Implemented
d: US President Donald Trump has issued an executive order directing that a number of sanctions, restrictions, and tariffs, stipulated by the recently enacted law on sanctions against Russia and Iran, not be applied.

t: Oil Tanker Explodes in Strait of Hormuz After It Hit Naval Mine – Reports
d: An oil tanker exploded in the Strait of Hormuz after hitting a naval mine, the Press TV channel reported, citing Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC).

d: Since Vladimir Zelensky took office in 2019, Ukraine has paid $124.3 billion toward its public debt, while the debt itself continues to grow, according to data from Ukraine’s Finance Ministry analyzed by Sputnik.

d: The US budget deficit reached $1.992 trillion in the 2025–2026 fiscal year, the Department of the Treasury said in its report released on Friday.

d: The Ukrainian military command assigns unfit-for-combat servicepeople to protect drone control points, a law enforcement source told Sputnik.

d: The Russian army has liberated the settlements of Palamarevka and Kovalevka in the Kharkov region, the Russian Defense Ministry said on Saturday.

t: Paris Region Police Say 40 People Detained Ahead of Upcoming Protests
d: Law enforcement officers in the Paris region carried out 40 detentions in the French capital and its suburbs ahead of upcoming large-scale protests, the Paris Police Prefecture said on Saturday.

t: Trump’s Russia Sanctions Waiver Makes Tariff Threat Lose Its Bite - Expert

t: Russian Nickel Supplies to EU Rise to Highest Level in Over 3 Years – Eurostat Data
d: Russia increased nickel supplies to the European Union by a fifth in August, bringing them to their highest level in three and a half years, according to Eurostat data reviewed by Sputnik.

t: Over 2,700 Drones Headed Toward Moscow Region in Week – Moscow Mayor
d: A total of 2,730 drones flew toward the Moscow Region over the past week, most were neutralized at long range, and 534 were destroyed on approach to the capital, Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said on Saturday.
